description: Vercel AI SDK v7 generateText with one tool and two Responses API steps.
notes: ai 7.0.162 does not emit spans. Spans come from @ai-sdk/otel OpenTelemetry, passed on telemetry.integrations, with runtimeContext enabled. runtimeContext holds sessionId, userId, and feature, recorded as ai.settings.context.*. Six spans: invoke_agent, two chat steps, two agent_step spans, and execute_tool. The agent span's input is the sum of the steps, 213, with cache_read 64. Each chat span keeps its own input, 82 then 131. functionId is not an attribute. providerMetadata and the ai.usage.* detail attributes are off by default.
